تشتملوا (form VIII)
# تَشْتَمِلُوا (taštamilū) /taʃ.ta.mi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
# تُشْتَمَلُوا (tuštamalū) /tuʃ.ta.ma.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِشْتَمَلَ (ištamala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
